job_post_detail.title: 电商运营-Local
job_post_detail.description:
1.负责韩国主流电商平台（Coupang/Naver Shopping等）店铺日常运营：商品上架、促销设置、关键词优化
2.结合韩国用户需求，策划并落地韩国新品、大促活动
3.监控竞品动态（定价策略、广告投放），输出数据日报及应对建议
4.处理韩语用户评论，洞察用户需求，方向提出对产品和促销的优化建议
5.基础数据分析，包括但不限于PSI 管理、流量、转化率等

1.E-commerce Platform Management
Oversee daily operations on leading Korean platforms (Coupang/Naver Shopping), including product listing, promotion configuration, and SEO keyword optimization.
2.Localized Campaign Execution
Develop and execute new product launches/peak season campaigns tailored to Korean consumer behavior insights.
3.Competitive Intelligence
Track competitor pricing tactics and advertising trends, delivering daily analytics reports with counter-strategies.
4.Customer Sentiment Analysis
Monitor/manage Korean-language reviews to extract actionable insights for product and promotional optimizations.
5.Core Metrics Analytics
Analyze PSI (Product Stock Index), traffic patterns, and conversion funnels to drive operational improvements.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1.学历专业：本科及以上，电子商务、韩语、国际贸易、数据分析相关专业优先
2.语言能力：韩语母语级别，中文熟练（能够使用中文与本地和总部沟通）
3.工具技能：熟练运用Microsoft office、Photoshop、AI等软件.
4.心态积极乐观，对销售岗位具备一定的心理承受力.
1.Bachelor's degree or above (preference for E-commerce, Korean Language Studies, International Trade, or Data Analytics majors).
2.Language Requirements:Native-level Korean proficiency, Business-fluent Chinese (effective communication with local/HQ teams required)
3.Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Photoshop, and Adobe Illustrator.
4.Professional Attributes: Resilient growth mindset with demonstrated capacity to excel in high-pressure sales environments.
